Tooltip_PPO_ProteinPowder:
While the body still holds protein, Strength and Fitness rise faster.
One serving lasts about a day.
Neat powder is drying - better mixed into water.
Tooltip_PPO_CreatineComplex:
While the body still holds creatine, Strength and Fitness rise faster.
One serving lasts about a day.
Neat powder is drying - better mixed into water.
Tooltip_PPO_CalorieGainer:
One scoop carries most of a day's calories, when food is short.
But keep drinking past that and it puts weight on.
Neat powder is drying - better mixed into water.
Tooltip_PPO_ElectrolyteComplex:
Gets the breath back fast - a mouthful mid-run or mid-fight puts you back on your feet.
Neat powder is drying - better mixed into water.
Tooltip_PPO_PreWorkoutStimulant:
While it lasts, training leaves no muscle strain: the arms answer the next morning.
Takes tiredness away.
But the effect never holds longer than two days, however much is drunk - extra servings are wasted.
Neat powder is drying - better mixed into water.
Tooltip_PPO_AnabolicPreparation:
A course raises the ceiling that Strength gains can be pushed to.
It does not bite at once - the effect builds over about a day.
But once the course ends, the body drops below normal, and stays there a long while.
Tooltip_PPO_CardioPreparation:
A course raises the ceiling that Fitness gains can be pushed to.
It does not bite at once - the effect builds over about a day.
But once the course ends, the body drops below normal, and stays there a long while.
Tooltip_PPO_ThermogenicComplex:
Drives the metabolism: while it lasts the body burns calories and weight comes off faster.
But the temperature stays high, and the heat brings hard thirst.
Weight keeps falling after the effect ends, until the calorie stock recovers.
